# Around the Mountain Pediatric Dentistry

> > A pediatric dental practice in Northern Arizona offering specialized care for children across Cottonwood, Lakeside, and Flagstaff locations.

Around the Mountain Pediatric Dentistry provides comprehensive pediatric dental services across three Arizona locations. The practice features multiple board-certified pediatric dentists and specializes in child-friendly dental care including innovative treatments like No Drill Dentistry and Silver Diamine Fluoride (SDF) therapy.
